'''Llane''' was a [[soldier]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]], Llane was part of [[Katha Niar]]'s team send to retrieve [[isotope-5]], but was killed when the forces of the [[Archon (Hutt)|Archon]] ambushed the Imperials and took some of them prisoner.<ref name="TOR" />
